text:
ashley: Heads up — noticed increased tail latency in eu-west2 this morning, looks like sustained egress bursts from tenant T-9 starting ~06:10 UTC.

sam: Any CPU/GPU saturation or just network?

ashley: Mostly network egress. GPU util stays normal. Short grep of proxy logs:```
2026-03-19T06:12:03Z proxy[route-12] tenant=T-9 tx_bytes=384MB p99=450ms
2026-03-19T06:12:10Z proxy[route-12] tenant=T-9 tx_bytes=512MB p99=780ms
2026-03-19T06:13:01Z proxy[route-12] tenant=T-9 tx_bytes=1.2GB p99=1.1s
```

mike: So noisy neighbor on shared egress. Is T-9 in a bursty batch job or inference hot-path?

ashley: They ramped up a large embed job overnight (customer reported), continuous uploads + streaming outputs.

priya: Can we try temporary egress shepherding: when tenant egress > 800MB/min for 3min, steer new requests to a warm dedicated slice (if available) or apply soft-policing on shared pool? We used a similar flow for CPU hogs.

sam: Sounds reasonable. Two questions: 1) how do we detect without false positives? 2) cost delta for spinning dedicated slices on short notice?

priya: For detection we can add a short-window EWMA on per-tenant tx rate + a minimum sustained window. For cost: warm dedicated slice = ~0.6x hourly burn vs cold cold spinup; estimated extra for eu-west2 hotspot is ~€30/hr for a single slice. If we gate with 3min sustained, frequency should be low.

ashley: Proposed config prototype:```yaml
egress_shepherding:
  detection:
    window: 180s
    threshold_bytes: 800000000   # 800MB
    ewma_alpha: 0.3
  actions:
    - if: dedicated_slice_available
      action: route_to_dedicated
      priority: high
    - else:
      action: soft_police
      rate_limit: 200mbps
      backoff_seconds: 30
```

devops-bot: [alert] eu-west2 proxy p99 tail > 800ms for shared pool between 06:10-06:25 UTC. Incident ID: IR-20260319-43

mike: How about rollout? Canary in eu-west2 with 5% burn first, monitor p99 and cost signal for 24h, then 25% if stable. Add a kill-switch that immediately reverts routing for >10% cost overrun.

priya: Agreed. Also add metric export for tenant-level egress cost attribution so CS can bill / warn the customer.

sam: One more: ensure this doesn't break dedicated SLA. Add check that we never preempt reserved-dedicated requests when creating warm slice.

ashley: I'll draft the PR with detection + routing hook + runbook updates. Will include a small load-test harness to simulate T-9 pattern. Targeting canary tomorrow morning UTC.

mike: Thanks — ping #oncall before canary. :thumbsup:

priya: Also notify finance for quick eyeball on possible transient cost. :money_with_wings:

sam: SGTM. If anyone sees rapid churn in warm slices we abort.

ashley: Updated runbook checklist will include: pre-checks, metric targets (p99 < 400ms), cost threshold, and rollback steps. Will post PR link here when ready.

devops-bot: Incident IR-20260319-43 closed (mitigated) — routing fallback applied at 06:26 UTC.

ashley: thanks — follow-up PR posted: https://git.company/redwood/infra/merge/8472 (contains config + tests)

sam: Review incoming.

priya: Nice work, let's watch the canary next 24h. :eyes:
